fields.Brand Customer Promise: A true extended-stay experience for midscale guests—fully equipped in-suite kitchens, lighter staffing, and franchise-first expertise—delivered through an efficient operating model and comprehensive owner support.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Residential-style suites with kitchens, living and work space, guest laundry, fitness, and social areas suited to stays of a week or more.

Owners: Lean operating model with significant labor savings; growing extended-stay demand; kitchen-in-a-box and lobby-in-a-box conversion paths; 20+ years of extended-stay expertise and dedicated national sales and opening services.

Choice: Integrated extended-stay team across development, sales, marketing, operations, and revenue management.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Midscale extended stay — in-suite kitchens, weekly housekeeping, and 11–12 FTE operating model vs. traditional nightly hotels.

Market tailwinds — demand growth expected to outpace supply; bleisure, infrastructure, and demographic drivers.

Conversion innovation — kitchen-in-a-box and lobby-in-a-box for faster upgrades from nightly hotels.

Franchise-first expertise — 70+ extended-stay experts and 150+ years combined experience on the operations team (materials).
fields.Brand History: MainStay Suites builds on Choice’s extended-stay leadership—from Jack DeBoer’s apartment-style living innovation (1975) and WoodSpring/ValuePlace lineage to a refreshed MainStay concept addressing guest and developer needs, alongside WoodSpring, Everhome, and Suburban Studios within Choice’s extended-stay portfolio.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Guests staying longer for grey-collar business and personal travel who need residential amenities, value operational simplicity, and choose extended stay over nightly hotels for assignments, relocation, and multi-week projects.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Efficient midscale extended-stay operating model vs. nightly hotels (length of stay, in-suite kitchen, lighter staffing).

Kitchen-in-a-box and lobby-in-a-box conversions with quoted delivery timelines (materials).

Dedicated Choice extended-stay team across development, sales, marketing, and operations.

Part of a portfolio addressing economy through midscale extended-stay demand growth.
